description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Cast Toxic Deluge by paying {2}{B}, and paying an amount of life equal to your life total minus 1.
Holding priority, activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
